chapters.title: Complex Numbers
chapters.main_concept: Extends the real number system to complex numbers a+ib: algebra of complex numbers (also as ordered pairs), Argand diagram, modulus, conjugate, square roots, factorisation of complex polynomials, cube and fourth roots of unity, polar form and operations in polar form, with applications to AC circuits (impedance) and simple cryptography.

chapters.title: Functions and Graphs
chapters.main_concept: Defines functions with domain, codomain and range, function notation, the vertical line test and types of functions (one-to-one, onto, bijective, piecewise); finds intersection points of linear and quadratic graphs graphically; graphs square-root and cube-root functions; applies exponential growth/decay models.

chapters.title: Theory of Quadratic Functions
chapters.main_concept: Analyses quadratic functions by sketching and completing the square to find maxima/minima, finds inverses of quadratic functions on restricted domains, solves absolute-value quadratic equations/inequalities and rational/radical equations reducible to quadratics, and models real-world problems.

chapters.main_concept: Covers types of matrices and operations (with real and complex entries), determinants of order 3 via minors/cofactors and properties, adjoint and inverse, elementary row operations, echelon/reduced echelon forms and rank, solution of non-homogeneous systems (reduced echelon, matrix inversion, Cramer's rule) and homogeneous systems (Gaussian elimination), with applications to reflections and coding.

chapters.title: Partial Fractions
chapters.main_concept: Distinguishes identities and conditional equations, proper and improper rational fractions, and resolves rational fractions into partial fractions for four cases of denominator factors (non-repeated/repeated linear, non-repeated/repeated irreducible quadratic).
